node.title: Quoting hash keys
node.author: Bod
node.doctext:
This follows on from [id://11138524] but it is a different question so it gets its own place!

In doing some of the reading that came out from [id://11138524], especially this on SO from [ikegami], I have noticed that often (but not always) hash keys are not quoted literals but barewords. Given the potential for confusion that has been shown from [id://11138524], it seems that this is another place where confusion could arise.

I have noticed this before but never really thought anything of it. my $value = $hash{ key }; I never write it like that. I always quote it unless the key is non-constant. my $value = $hash{'key'}; my $value = $hash{ $key_value }; my $value = $hash{"st_$id"};

Is there a difference between $hash{ key } and $hash{'key'}?
